_comment: HAND-AUTHORED, NOT HARVESTED. The point of this fixture is to be a stable gate:
if it were built from the user's real skill library, every skill written or pruned
would move the numbers and the floors would stop meaning anything. The library
below is synthetic but shaped like a real one — twelve skills a personal assistant
would plausibly accumulate, several of them deliberately adjacent (lunch menu vs
restaurant booking, invoice reminder vs VAT return) so a query has to discriminate
rather than just find the only plausible entry.
Descriptions follow the contract in src/server/skills/contract.ts: one sentence, at
most 160 characters, saying WHEN to reach for the skill and never restating the name.
langPair mirrors recall-golden.json: the user writes Slovak about half the time, and
skill descriptions are English, so sk->en is a real retrieval condition and gets its
own floor.

skills.name: extract-video-captions
skills.description: When someone wants what a video says without watching it, pull the auto-generated transcript rather than describing frames.

skills.name: scrape-daily-lunch-menu
skills.description: Reach for this when the question is what a specific restaurant is serving today and the answer lives on a page that changes daily.

skills.name: book-restaurant-table
skills.description: Use when a place and a time are named and a reservation has to be placed through the venue's own booking widget.

skills.name: track-parcel-delivery
skills.description: For a tracking number whose current whereabouts are wanted, when the carrier's public page is the only source of truth.

skills.name: check-flight-status
skills.description: When a departure or arrival time is in doubt on the day of travel and the airline's schedule page has to be read directly.

skills.name: renew-domain-registration
skills.description: Use when a domain is close to expiry and the renewal has to be pushed through the registrar's control panel before it lapses.

skills.name: file-vat-return-slovakia
skills.description: For the quarterly submission to the Slovak tax portal, where the form order and the deadline both matter.

skills.name: draft-invoice-reminder-email
skills.description: When a customer is late paying and a polite chaser has to go out that still keeps the door open.

skills.name: compare-lease-buyout-offers
skills.description: Use when a car is coming off lease and the question is whether the buyout price beats what the market would pay.

skills.name: diagnose-home-assistant-automation
skills.description: When an automation silently stops firing and the trace log has to be read to find which condition blocked it.

skills.name: reset-router-port-forwarding
skills.description: For the case where a self-hosted service stops answering from outside the house after the ISP rotates the address.

skills.name: convert-heic-photos
skills.description: When iPhone photos will not open on a machine that expects ordinary image files and a batch has to be converted.

queries.text: summarise this youtube video for me, I don't want to sit through 40 minutes
what's the daily menu at the bistro across the street today?
book us a table at Modrá Hviezda for Friday at seven
where is my package right now, tracking number is CE123456789SK
is the Vienna flight delayed this morning?
awantech.sk expires in two weeks, sort the renewal out
I need to submit the quarterly VAT to the tax office
this client still hasn't paid the September invoice, write them something
the lease ends in March, is it worth buying the car out or selling it
the lights automation hasn't run in three days and I don't know why
I can't reach my nextcloud from outside anymore, worked yesterday
these photos from my phone won't open on the laptop
čo dnes varia na obed v tej reštaurácii pri kancelárii?
prosím pozri o čom je toto video, nechce sa mi to pozerať celé
kde je moja zásielka, mala prísť už včera
zákazník stále nezaplatil faktúru, napíš mu slušnú upomienku
automatizácia so svetlami sa už tri dni nespustila, netuším prečo
fotky z iphonu sa mi nedajú otvoriť na notebooku
o dva týždne mi vyprší doména, treba ju predĺžiť
mešká ráno let do Viedne?

_comment: Baseline observed with multilingual-e5-small (the app default) over these 20 queries,
ranking `name\ndescription` exactly as skillVectorText does in src/server/skills/vectors.ts:
@5 1.000, mrr 0.681. Each floor sits about one query below that — 1/20 overall, 1/8 on
sk->en — so a single query flipping does not fail the gate but a systematic regression does.
sk->en is floored lower on purpose rather than fixed by rewriting the queries: e5 squashes
cross-language similarity (the same effect recall-golden.json documents), and a fixture
tuned until the number looked good would stop reporting that.
